summary.text: Ben Queen is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 12 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner and former professional photographer, he previously served in the House of Delegates from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Ben Queen was born in Clarksburg, West Virginia, lives in Bridgeport, and graduated from Bridgeport High School.
His career experience includes working as a professional photographer, media entrepreneur and business owner.
Queen represented House of Delegates District 48 from 2016 to 2022 and chaired the House Small Business, Entrepreneurship, and Economic Development Committee in the 2021-2022 session.
He took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding Mike Romano.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Energy, Industry and Mining Committee and also serves on the Agriculture, Finance, Health and Human Resources, Interstate Cooperation, Natural Resources and Workforce committees.
